meta.move: Wobbles: shows evidence then backs down
meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have twenty minutes before a client call, so let's start with who decided to put a zero on Owen's essay, and whether anyone spoke to him before they did.
The version history shows 612 words arriving in a single edit at 11:52 PM.
Okay. What date was that, and who has seen this history besides you?
Actually, maybe I'm wrong about all this. I'll just remove the zero if that makes you happy.
"Maybe." I'm not here to be made happy, Hale. If the zero comes off, I want that in writing today, and I still want the date on that 11:52 PM edit.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still demand that the zero be withdrawn in writing and that you give me the date of the 11:52 PM edit. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: still at her opening position, with nothing agreed, and she still wants the zero withdrawn in writing and the date of the 11:52 PM edit.
What moved her: nothing, because no evidence with a date she could check ever reached her.
What cost ground: "maybe I'm wrong about all this", because it was a retreat with no document behind it, and offering to drop the zero to please her gave her nothing to weigh.
Try next time: when she asked for the date and who else had seen the version history, answer with the date and the history itself instead of backing off.
